corrections.old_text: ፬ ቓል ውሃ አምጡ ብሎ ደግ
corrections.corrected_text: ፬ ጋን ውሃ አምጡ ብሎ ደግ
corrections.reason: In 1 Kings 18:33, Elijah says to fill four jars (፬ ጋን ውሃ አምጡ). Visually, the printed glyphs after ፬ are ጋን (4th order ጋ followed by 6th order ን), misread as ቓል.
The word is እንዳባወቀ (from ማባወቅ, as he made it known/revealed). Visually, ዳ (4th order) has the left-slanted leg, misread as ዲ.
The traditional Amharic term for a sharp flint/cutting stone is ሻፎ ደንጊያ (which separates flesh from bone). Visually, the first glyph is 4th order ሻ with a shorter right leg, misread as 6th order ሽ.
The word የመናፍቃንን wraps across the page boundary to the next page (which begins with ን ትምርት ያሰናክላልና).
